rust/mirage-rs/src/cli/gh/ and rust/mirage-rs/src/core/github/ follow gh
2.85.0 (https://github.com/cli/cli): the commands of its pkg/cmd and their
output, the REST and GraphQL calls of its api package, the GraphQL selection
it sends for each --json field and its export of the answer (ExportData), the
way its Author, ReactionGroups and Owner types marshal themselves, the query
builder of its pkg/search, its diffHeaderRegexp and the --limit refusals of
gh 2.46. The command tree, flags and flag descriptions in
python/mirage/commands/cli/builtin/gh/ and
typescript/packages/core/src/commands/cli/builtin/gh/ are the ones gh declares,
and python/mirage/commands/cli/cobra.py and
typescript/packages/core/src/commands/cli/cobra.ts print its usage block as its
root command does.
